title: QA_Platform_aggregate_savings_unknown_stage
preconditions: Authenticated buyer of the run's client; the path id decodes to 999999999, which has no trade_requests row.
steps: 2. Expect 422 code 4 and no savings payload.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 4 'Request not found' from TradeController#aggregate_savings (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:563) - find_by_id returns nil for id 999999999 and the action stops before authorize.
rationale: Bogus-id guard on the savings read; a regression would dereference nil in the policy or in savings_configuration and 500.

title: QA_Platform_aggregate_savings_undecodable_id
preconditions: Authenticated buyer; the path id is an undecodable uuid (decodes to nil).
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 4 'Request not found' - the id decodes to nil, find_by_id(nil) is nil and app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:563 answers before authorize.
rationale: Guards the nil-id path: the sibling action alternate_bidding_leader_board authorizes nil and crashes, this one must not.

title: QA_Platform_aggregate_savings_closed_rfq_without_savings_config
preconditions: The journey RFQ is closed with one submitted bid and was created without a savings configuration.
steps: 2. Expect 200; savings null or a list of custom savings.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with savings null (no savings configuration on the journey RFQ and custom savings off), or a list of custom savings when the client uses custom savings. Never 5xx. app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:567-571, app/models/model_helpers/trade_request_model_helper.rb:668.
rationale: Exercises the no-configuration branch on a stage that has real bids and a proposal; nil configuration must short-circuit cleanly.

title: QA_Platform_aggregate_savings_live_rfq_no_bids
preconditions: The sandbox RFQ is live with an open bid window and no bids.
expectedResult: Either 200 with savings null, or 422 code 577 when event masking applies to the caller. Never 5xx. app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:567-568.
rationale: The live, no-bid state is where best-amount lookups return nil; the read must stay safe.

title: QA_Platform_aggregate_savings_on_rfp_stage
preconditions: rfp_rfq run; the technical stage of the sandbox event exists.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with savings null - RFP stages carry no savings configuration (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:568). Never 5xx.
rationale: Wrong stage type for a price endpoint; must degrade to empty.

title: QA_Platform_line_savings_unknown_stage
preconditions: Authenticated buyer; the path id decodes to 999999999.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 4 'Request not found' (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:576) - find_by_id returns nil before the policy runs.
rationale: Bogus-id guard on the per-line savings read.

title: QA_Platform_line_savings_closed_rfq_without_savings_config
preconditions: The journey RFQ is closed with one submitted bid and no savings configuration.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with an empty object when the stage has no savings configuration (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:583-587), or a map keyed by line uuid when custom savings are on. Never 5xx.
rationale: No-configuration branch with real bids present.

title: QA_Platform_l1_data_unknown_stage
preconditions: Authenticated buyer; the path id decodes to 999999999.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 4 'Request not found' (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:552) - find_by_id nil, answered before authorize.
rationale: Bogus-id guard on the L1 read used by bulk counter offers.

title: QA_Platform_l1_data_live_rfq_no_bids
preconditions: The sandbox RFQ is live with no bids.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with an empty object - no participant scores yet (app/controllers/concerns/trade_template_helper.rb:391). Never 5xx.
rationale: Empty-state boundary of the L1 read.

title: QA_Platform_l1_data_after_award_no_crash
preconditions: The journey RFQ is closed with one bid and a submitted award proposal (approved directly when no approval flow applies).
expectedResult: HTTP 200 (L1 line values or an empty object). Must not 5xx. Suspected crash: app/controllers/concerns/trade_template_helper.rb:396 loads bid lines with status active/requested only, then app/controllers/concerns/trade_template_helper.rb:402 calls select on nil when the L1 vendor line is selected (awarded).
rationale: Status filter mismatch between ranking (active, selected, requested) and the L1 line lookup (active, requested) - a nil dereference after award.

title: QA_Platform_schema_l1_prices_no_bids
preconditions: The sandbox RFQ is live with no bids.
steps: 1. GET the sandbox schema with l1_prices=true.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 and l1_prices with empty lot_based and line_item_based maps (app/controllers/concerns/trade_template_helper.rb:416). Never 5xx.
rationale: Empty-state boundary of the L1 prices block used to seed auctions.

title: QA_Platform_schema_l1_prices_false_still_computed
preconditions: The journey RFQ is closed with one submitted bid.
steps: 1. GET the journey schema with l1_prices=false.
2. Expect 200; note whether l1_prices is present.
expectedResult: HTTP 200, never 5xx. Note: l1_prices is computed for any non-empty value (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:439), so the block is present even for false.
rationale: Truthy-string parameter parsing on a price-revealing flag.

title: QA_Platform_event_indicators_on_rfp_stage
preconditions: rfp_rfq run; the sandbox technical stage exists.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with auction_identifiers and a data map without prices. Never 5xx. app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:531-547.
rationale: Wrong stage type for a rank endpoint the dashboard nevertheless calls (rfx_mode is not rfi).

title: QA_Platform_event_indicators_live_no_bids
preconditions: The sandbox RFQ is live with no bids.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with an empty auction_identifiers_data map (no ranked bids), or an empty body when masking applies. Never 5xx. app/services/sourcing_engine/auction_indicators_service.rb:24-34.
rationale: No-bid boundary of the indicators service.

title: QA_Platform_event_indicators_single_bid_is_best
preconditions: The journey RFQ is closed with exactly one submitted bid.
steps: 2. Expect 200; one vendor, best_bidder true per line.
expectedResult: HTTP 200; auction_identifiers_data has one vendor key and that vendor is best_bidder on every line (rank 1 when ranks are shown). Never 5xx. app/services/sourcing_engine/auction_indicators_service.rb:131-160.
rationale: Base oracle for L1 marking on a closed stage with real data.

title: QA_Platform_event_indicators_undecodable_id
preconditions: Authenticated buyer; the path id decodes to nil.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 4 'Request not found' - the id decodes to nil and validate_event returns 4 (app/controllers/concerns/trade_controller_helper.rb:2215).
rationale: Nil-decode path of the indicators read (complements AUC-RANK-003 which uses a substituted id).

title: QA_Platform_rejected_bids_unknown_stage
preconditions: Authenticated buyer; the path id decodes to 999999999.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 4 'Request not found' - find_by nil then validate_event returns 4 (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:600-602).
rationale: Bogus-id guard on the rejected-bids read.

title: QA_Platform_rejected_bids_none
preconditions: The journey RFQ is closed with one active bid; no bid was rejected.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with an empty object - no bid on the journey RFQ has status rejected (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:605-619). Never 5xx.
rationale: Empty-state boundary of the rejected-bids read.

title: QA_Platform_bidder_remarks_unknown_stage
preconditions: Authenticated buyer; the path id decodes to 999999999.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 4 'Request not found' (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:624-627).
rationale: Bogus-id guard on the remarks read.

title: QA_Platform_bidder_remarks_closed_rfq
preconditions: The journey RFQ is closed with one submitted bid.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with an array (empty unless the vendor typed remarks); draft and in_active bids are excluded (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:630). Never 5xx.
rationale: Happy-path read with the remarks filter on a stage with a real bid.

title: QA_Platform_quote_details_paging_without_tabs
preconditions: The journey RFQ is a non-BOQ event (no tabs) and is closed with bid {{bidUuid}}.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with the quote (tab and page ignored on a non-BOQ event). Must not 5xx. Suspected crash: app/controllers/concerns/trade_controller_helper.rb:6341 indexes trade.tabs, which is nil on non-BOQ events; the event-group version of the helper guards blank tabs.
rationale: Unguarded nil index in the paging helper; only BOQ clients send tab/page, so non-BOQ coverage is missing.

title: QA_Platform_quote_details_unknown_bid
preconditions: The journey RFQ is closed; the quote id decodes to 999999999.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 32 'Bid not found' - no BidTrade row links bid 999999999 to the stage (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:731-732).
rationale: Bogus quote id on the vendor-quote read.

title: QA_Platform_quote_details_bid_from_other_stage
preconditions: The journey bid {{bidUuid}} exists on the journey RFQ; {{tradeId}} is the separate sandbox RFQ.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 32 'Bid not found' - the BidTrade lookup is scoped by bid id and trade_request id (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:731), and the journey bid is not on the sandbox stage.
rationale: Cross-stage object reference: a bid must only be readable through its own stage.

title: QA_Platform_quote_details_bid_id_on_rfp_stage
preconditions: rfp_rfq run; the sandbox technical stage exists; {{bidUuid}} is an RFQ bid from the journey event.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 4 'Request not found' - on an RFP stage the quote id is looked up as a template response of that stage (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:666-667).
rationale: Wrong stage type for the quote id; ids from different tables must not be confused.

title: QA_Platform_quote_details_without_additional_requests
preconditions: The journey RFQ is closed with bid {{bidUuid}}.
steps: 1. GET the journey quote with additional_request_bid_required=false.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with sheet_uuid equal to the bid uuid and inline_data for the quoted line (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:789-799). Never 5xx.
rationale: Parameter branch of the quote read on real data.

title: QA_Platform_quote_summary_without_tabs
preconditions: The sandbox RFQ is a non-BOQ event (no tabs).
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 101 'You are not allowed to perform this action' - trade.tabs is blank on a non-BOQ stage (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:813), checked before the bid lookup.
rationale: Guard order: the tab check answers before the bogus bid id matters.
notRunnable: the web console app is not enabled for this action (config/app_auth_config.yml → client_admin_dashboard has no "quote_summary"), so the buyer's console session gets 401 "This app is not authorized to use this API" — and every 401 marks that session logged out (json_helpers.rb check_session_validity), which would end the run for every case after it. It needs the app this endpoint is enabled for (the vendor/mobile client).

title: QA_Platform_leader_board_unknown_stage
preconditions: Authenticated buyer; the path id decodes to 999999999.
expectedResult: A 4xx (expected 422 code 4). Must not 5xx. Suspected crash: app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:867-868 calls authorize on a nil trade before validate_event; Pundit raises NotDefinedError, which ApiAuth does not rescue.
rationale: Wrong guard order: authorize(nil) before the existence check.

title: QA_Platform_leader_board_undecodable_id
preconditions: Authenticated buyer; the path id decodes to nil.
expectedResult: A 4xx. Must not 5xx. The id decodes to nil, find_by_id(nil) is nil and authorize nil raises Pundit NotDefinedError (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:867-868).
rationale: Nil-decode variant of the authorize(nil) crash.

title: QA_Platform_leader_board_alternate_bidding_off
preconditions: The sandbox RFQ has is_alternate_bidding_allowed OFF.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 101 'You are not allowed to perform this action' - the stage does not allow alternate bidding (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:871).
rationale: Feature-off gate on the leader board.

title: QA_Platform_bid_visibility_users_when_not_locked
preconditions: lock_bid_by_default is OFF for the client, so the sandbox RFQ does not lock bids.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 10 'You are not allowed to use this functionality' - the stage does not lock bids (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:1304).
rationale: Feature gate in front of a list of finance users with emails.

title: QA_Platform_bid_visibility_users_unknown_stage
preconditions: Authenticated buyer; the path id decodes to 999999999.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 4 'Request not found' - no active stage with that id in the caller workspace (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:1300-1301).
rationale: Bogus-id guard on the unlock-flow read.

title: QA_Platform_unlock_otp_without_user
preconditions: Authenticated buyer; sandbox RFQ.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 2 'Insufficient parameters' - user_id is blank (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:1250-1252); nothing is sent.
rationale: Missing-field guard in front of an OTP send.

title: QA_Platform_unlock_otp_to_non_finance_user
preconditions: lock_bid_by_default is OFF; the target user is the run's own buyer.
steps: 1. POST send_otp_for_unlocking_bids naming the run's own buyer.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 10 'You are not allowed to use this functionality' - the run buyer is not a finance user (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:1255) and the stage does not lock bids (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:1260); either guard gives 10.
rationale: Role gate on who may receive the unlock OTP.

title: QA_Platform_unlock_otp_unknown_user
preconditions: Authenticated buyer; the user uuid decodes to 999999999.
steps: 1. POST send_otp_for_unlocking_bids with a bogus user_uuid.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 2 'Insufficient parameters' - no active user 999999999 (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:1253-1254).
rationale: Bogus recipient on the OTP send.

title: QA_Platform_unlock_verify_without_otp
preconditions: Authenticated buyer; sandbox RFQ.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 2 'Insufficient parameters' - otp is blank (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:1276-1278); visibility is not updated.
rationale: Missing OTP must never unlock sealed bids.

title: QA_Platform_unlock_verify_wrong_otp
preconditions: lock_bid_by_default is OFF; the target user is the run's own buyer.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 10 'You are not allowed to use this functionality' - the run buyer is not a finance user and the stage does not lock bids (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:1280,1285). Visibility is never updated.
rationale: A wrong OTP must never reach update_bid_visibility.

title: QA_Platform_bid_template_unknown_company
preconditions: The sandbox RFQ is live (status active); the company uuid decodes to 999999999.
expectedResult: A 4xx (company not found). Must not 5xx. Suspected crash: app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:1051 passes Company.find_by(id: 999999999) = nil as current_workspace and the Excel service dereferences it in its constructor (app/services/procol_excel/trade_request_details_service.rb:26). The crash happens before any Report row is written.
rationale: Unvalidated id parameter dereferenced in a service constructor.

title: QA_Platform_bid_template_undecodable_id
preconditions: Authenticated buyer; the path id decodes to nil.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 2 'Insufficient parameters' - the id decodes to nil and app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:1042 refuses it.
rationale: Nil-id guard on the template download.

title: QA_Platform_bid_template_unknown_stage
preconditions: Authenticated buyer; the path id decodes to 999999999.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 4 'Request not found' - no active or draft stage with id 999999999 (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:1043-1044).
rationale: Bogus-id guard on the template download.

title: QA_Platform_bid_template_closed_rfq
preconditions: The journey RFQ is past its bid end with one bid and a submitted proposal.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with excel_url while the stage status is active, or 422 code 4 when it is closed (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:1043-1044). Never 5xx. On success one Report and one ReportDownloadLog row are written for the run buyer.
rationale: State boundary of the template download after close/award.

title: QA_Platform_vendor_logs_refused_for_client_buyer
preconditions: The caller is the run's client buyer (not a Procol employee); the journey RFQ is closed.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 455 'You are not authorized to perform this action' - trade_history? allows Procol employees only (app/policies/trade_request_policy.rb:204-206), rescued by api_auth.rb:117.

It needs the app this endpoint is enabled for (the vendor/mobile client).

title: QA_Platform_vendor_logs_unknown_stage
preconditions: Authenticated client buyer; the path id decodes to 999999999.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 4 'Request not found' - validate_event runs before the employee-only authorize (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:1414-1418).
rationale: Guard order pin: existence check precedes the permission check.
notRunnable: the web console app is not enabled for this action (config/app_auth_config.yml → client_admin_dashboard has no "trade_history"), so the buyer's console session gets 401 "This app is not authorized to use this API" — and every 401 marks that session logged out (json_helpers.rb check_session_validity), which would end the run for every case after it. It needs the app this endpoint is enabled for (the vendor/mobile client).

title: QA_Platform_comparison_export_empty_request
preconditions: Authenticated buyer.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 2 'Insufficient parameters' - item_type and item_id are both missing (app/controllers/api/reports_controller.rb:108-109).
rationale: Missing-field guard on the export endpoint.

title: QA_Platform_mqcs_export_undecodable_event
preconditions: Authenticated buyer; the item uuid decodes to nil.
steps: 1. POST /reports/download_report for an event_group with item_uuid WrongUuid1=.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 2 'Insufficient parameters' - item_uuid decodes to a nil item_id (app/controllers/api/reports_controller.rb:108-109).
rationale: Nil-decode guard on the master QCS export body the dashboard sends.

title: QA_Platform_export_unsupported_item_type
preconditions: Authenticated buyer; sandbox RFQ.
steps: 2. Expect a 4xx; a 204 is the defect.
expectedResult: Expected a 4xx (Insufficient or Invalid Parameters). Today the action renders nothing for an item_type outside the supported list (app/controllers/api/reports_controller.rb:114) and Rails answers 204 No Content - a silent success.
rationale: Unsupported enum value falls through without a response.

title: QA_Platform_mqcs_export_unknown_event
preconditions: Authenticated buyer; the item uuid decodes to 999999999.
expectedResult: A 4xx (404 from ActiveRecord RecordNotFound raised by find at app/controllers/api/reports_controller.rb:124). Never 5xx; no report is generated.
rationale: Bogus id on the export: find raises; must map to 404, not 500.

title: QA_Platform_mqcs_regenerate_empty_list_policy_first

rationale: Guard-order pin for the regeneration endpoint.
notRunnable: the web console app is not enabled for this action (config/app_auth_config.yml → client_admin_dashboard has no "regenerate_master_qcs"), so the buyer's console session gets 401 "This app is not authorized to use this API" — and every 401 marks that session logged out (json_helpers.rb check_session_validity), which would end the run for every case after it. It needs the app this endpoint is enabled for (the vendor/mobile client).

title: QA_Platform_mqcs_regenerate_over_cap_policy_first
preconditions: The caller is the run's client buyer, not on the regeneration allow-list.
steps: 1. POST regenerate_master_qcs with the sandbox event group uuid repeated 11 times.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 455 'You are not authorized to perform this action' - the policy answers before the 10-id cap (app/controllers/api/event_groups_controller.rb:1041,1047).

notRunnable: the web console app is not enabled for this action (config/app_auth_config.yml → client_admin_dashboard has no "regenerate_master_qcs"), so the buyer's console session gets 401 "This app is not authorized to use this API" — and every 401 marks that session logged out (json_helpers.rb check_session_validity), which would end the run for every case after it. It needs the app this endpoint is enabled for (the vendor/mobile client).

title: QA_Platform_mqcs_schema_without_view_type
preconditions: Authenticated buyer; sandbox event group.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 2 'Insufficient parameters' - validate_params before_action (app/controllers/api/sheets_controller.rb:189).
rationale: Missing view type on the Master QCS read.

title: QA_Platform_mqcs_schema_unknown_event
preconditions: Authenticated buyer; the event group uuid decodes to 999999999.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 4 'Request not found' - no active or withdrawn event group 999999999 (app/controllers/api/sheets_controller.rb:174-175).
rationale: Bogus-id guard on the Master QCS schema.

title: QA_Platform_mqcs_schema_live_no_bids
preconditions: The sandbox event is active with a live RFQ and no bids.
steps: 1. GET the sandbox Master QCS summary schema.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with sheets, layers and page_size (no bid layers yet), or an empty 204 when masking applies (app/controllers/api/sheets_controller.rb:16). Never 5xx.
rationale: Empty-state Master QCS read.

title: QA_Platform_mqcs_schema_unknown_view_type
preconditions: Authenticated buyer; sandbox event group.
steps: 2. Expect a 4xx; a 200 with only page_size is the defect.
expectedResult: Expected a 4xx (code 888 Invalid Parameters exists at app/controllers/api/sheets_controller.rb:181 for exactly this). Today no branch matches (app/controllers/api/sheets_controller.rb:12,31,50) and the action answers 200 with only page_size.
rationale: Invalid enum accepted silently.

title: QA_Platform_mqcs_details_unknown_view_type
preconditions: Authenticated buyer; sandbox event group.
steps: 2. Expect a 4xx; a 204 is the defect.
expectedResult: Expected a 4xx. Today none of the view_type branches match (app/controllers/api/sheets_controller.rb:78,121,145), nothing is rendered and Rails answers 204 No Content.
rationale: Action with no fallback render.

title: QA_Platform_mqcs_schema_unknown_lot
preconditions: Sandbox event without lots.
steps: 1. GET the sandbox Master QCS schema with lot_no 999.
expectedResult: Never 5xx. Today the unknown lot has no stage, masking is reported true and the masked branch returns before render (app/controllers/api/sheets_controller.rb:16), so the answer is 204 No Content.
rationale: Unknown lot reaches the masking precedence quirk; must at least not crash.

title: QA_Platform_mqcs_po_view_unknown_proposal
preconditions: Authenticated buyer; the proposal uuid decodes to 999999999.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 2 'Insufficient parameters' - no proposal 999999999 (app/controllers/api/sheets_controller.rb:177-178).
rationale: Bogus proposal on the PO view.

title: QA_Platform_mqcs_details_paging_without_tabs
preconditions: Sandbox event, non-BOQ (no tabs).
steps: 1. GET /sheets/details with tab=0 and page=1 on the sandbox event.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 (or 204 when masked). Never 5xx - set_pagination_for_event_group_line_items returns early when the event has no tabs (app/controllers/concerns/event_group_controller_helper.rb:209).
rationale: Contrast with the stage-level helper that lacks the blank-tabs guard.

title: QA_Platform_mqcs_schema_foreign_proposal

steps: 1. GET the sandbox awarding_view schema with the journey proposal uuid.
2. Expect no 5xx; note whether the foreign proposal changes the grid.

title: QA_Platform_mqcs_template_unknown
preconditions: Authenticated buyer; the template id decodes to 999999999.
expectedResult: A 4xx: set_template finds no active MQCS template 999999999 for the company and answers error code 2 (app/controllers/api/report_templates_controller.rb:70-76). If the web app is not configured for this controller the refusal is app_error_auth_failed instead.
rationale: Bogus id on the MQCS template read.

title: QA_Platform_mqcs_template_availability
preconditions: Authenticated buyer.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with template_available, template_id and template_name for the caller company (app/controllers/api/report_templates_controller.rb:53-64). Never 5xx.
rationale: Read used by the Master QCS export to choose a layout.

title: QA_Platform_exchange_rates_on_single_currency_stage
preconditions: The sandbox RFQ has no currency configuration (single-currency stage).
steps: 1. PATCH /v1/trade/{{tradeId}}/currency_exchange_rates with a negative USD rate.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 879 'Multi-currency is not configured for this trade request.' (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:1472). Every later branch also refuses this body (negative rate gives 878), so nothing is saved.
rationale: Feature-off guard on the rate update.

title: QA_Platform_exchange_rates_after_bids
preconditions: The journey RFQ is closed with one bid.
steps: 1. PATCH currency_exchange_rates on the journey RFQ.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with code 879 (single-currency stage, app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:1472) or 877 (bids already placed, app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:1473). Either way nothing is saved; the negative rate would also be refused (878).
rationale: State guard: rates are frozen once bidding has data.

title: QA_Platform_stage_read_unknown_history_bid
preconditions: The sandbox RFQ is live; the bid uuid decodes to 999999999.
expectedResult: A 4xx (expected 422 code 32). Must not 5xx. Suspected crash: app/controllers/api/trade_controller.rb:1112 finds no bid 999999999 on the stage and app/controllers/api/trade_controller.rb:1113 calls status on nil.
rationale: Nil dereference on an optional query parameter of the stage read.

title: QA_Platform_stage_read_non_numeric_history_bid
preconditions: The sandbox RFQ is live.
expectedResult: A 4xx. Must not 5xx. The raw id abc matches no bid, bid is nil and app/controllers/api/trade_controller.rb:1113 calls status on it.
rationale: Wrong-type value on the raw form of the bid-history parameter.

title: QA_Platform_stage_read_history_for_real_bid
preconditions: The journey RFQ is closed with bid {{bidUuid}}.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with the stage and the vendor layer built from all bids of that vendor (app/controllers/api/trade_controller.rb:1111-1115). Never 5xx.
rationale: Happy path of the bid-history parameter on real data.

title: QA_Platform_auction_report_unknown_stage
preconditions: Authenticated buyer; the path id decodes to 999999999.
expectedResult: A 4xx. Must not 5xx. Suspected crash: app/controllers/api/trade_controller.rb:1627-1628 wraps a nil find_by in T.must, which raises TypeError.
rationale: Sorbet T.must used as a not-found check.

title: QA_Platform_event_summary_zero_rank_limit
preconditions: Authenticated buyer; sandbox RFQ.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 2 'Insufficient parameters' - rank_limit must be positive (app/controllers/api/trade_controller.rb:1714-1715).
rationale: Lower boundary of rank_limit.
